point_1.title: Point at Someone
point_1.description: Choose one person to take a penalty.
point_1.rules:
Select **1 player** from the list below and confirm.

That person takes **1 penalty**. No arguments: whoever you point at, loses.

point_2.title: Point at Two
point_2.description: Choose two people to take a penalty.
point_2.rules:
Select **2 players** from the list below and confirm.

Both take **1 penalty each**. You can point at whoever you want.

point_3.title: Point at Three
point_3.description: Choose three people to take a penalty.
point_3.rules:
Select **3 players** from the list below and confirm.

All three take **1 penalty each**. You can point at whoever you want.

all_men.title: All Men
all_men.description: All men at the table take a penalty.
all_men.rules:
All **men** present in the match take **1 penalty**.

Select all of them from the list to update the leaderboard.

all_women.title: All Women
all_women.description: All women at the table take a penalty.
all_women.rules:
All **women** present in the match take **1 penalty**.

Select all of them from the list to update the leaderboard.

everyone.title: Everyone Loses
everyone.description: Everyone at the table takes a penalty.
everyone.rules:
**Everyone** at the table takes **1 penalty**.

Select all players from the list to update the leaderboard.

reverso.title: Reverse
reverso.description: The last person who penalized you now takes the hit.
reverso.rules:
Select **who was the last person that penalized you** during the game.

That person takes **1 penalty** now.

If nobody penalized you yet, the card has no effect. Pass your turn.

never_have_i.title: Never Have I Ever
never_have_i.description: The player makes a statement starting with 'Never have I ever...'. Anyone who has done it gets a penalty.
never_have_i.rules:
The card drawer makes a statement: **"Never have I ever [done something]"**.

Everyone who **has already done** that takes **1 penalty**.

**Example:** *"Never have I ever been abroad"*. Anyone who has traveled gets penalized.

Mark whoever lost on the list below.

putinha.title: Sidekick Game
putinha.description: Choose a player. Every time you get penalized, that person does too (up to 3 times).
putinha.rules:
The card drawer chooses **1 player** to link to themselves.

For the next **3 times** the drawer gets penalized, the linked player gets penalized along automatically.

- The link appears in the **active rules bar** at the top
- It disappears automatically after 3 penalties
- The linked player cannot refuse

pi_game.title: The Pi Game
pi_game.description: Count around the table. Say 'Pi' instead of multiples of 3 or numbers containing the digit 3 (e.g., 13, 30, 33). Whoever messes up loses.
pi_game.rules:
Count out loud around the table **clockwise**, starting with the drawer.

**Rule:** every time the number is a **multiple of 3** (3, 6, 9...) **or contains the digit 3** (13, 23, 30, 31, 32, 33...), say **"Pi"** instead of the number.

- Whoever says the wrong number **loses**
- Whoever forgets to say Pi **loses**
- The round continues until someone messes up

cs_compound.title: No C, M, or Compound Words
cs_compound.description: Forbidden to say words starting with C or M, and compound words. Whoever messes up loses.
cs_compound.shortRule: No C, M, or compound words
cs_compound.rules:
The card drawer chooses a theme and says a starting word. Going clockwise, everyone must say a single word within that theme, but with strict restrictions:

**Forbidden:**
- Words starting with the letters **C** or **M** (Watch out for automatic answers like *Car*, *Coffee*, *Movie*, *Milk*...)
- **Compound words** made by joining two words together into one (e.g., *Cupcake*, *Basketball*, *Raincoat*, *Sunscreen*)

Whoever says a forbidden word, repeats a word, or takes too long **loses**.

frog_game.title: The Frog Game
frog_game.description: Going clockwise, everyone says one word from the sequence: One → Frog → Fell → Into → The → Pond → Splash. The count grows each round. Whoever messes up loses.
frog_game.shortRule: One frog fell into the pond, splash!
frog_game.rules:
Going **clockwise** starting from the drawer, each player says **one word** of the sequence:

**One → Frog → Fell → Into → The → Pond → Splash**

After "Splash", the number **Two** begins, but now each word repeats twice:

*Two → Two → Frog → Frog → Fell → Fell → Into → Into → The → The → Pond → Pond → Splash → Splash*

With each new round, the repetition increases. The game doesn't stop between rounds.

Whoever **hesitates** or says the **wrong** word loses.

pim_pow_pam.title: Pim Pow Pam
pim_pow_pam.description: Play Pim Pow Pam around the table. Whoever messes up the sequence or the direction loses.
pim_pow_pam.shortRule: Pim and Pow follow the circle; on Pam, point to the next!
pim_pow_pam.rules:
The card drawer starts by saying **"Pim"**. The next player clockwise says **"Pow"**. The third player must say **"Pam"** and, obligatorily, **point at any person** at the table. The game immediately restarts with the pointed person saying **"Pim"**, and the sequence continues from them.

**Loses who:**
- Says the wrong word in the sequence
- Takes too long to answer
- Forgets to point on "Pam"
- Says "Pim" out of turn (without being pointed at in the previous turn)

salute.title: Salute
salute.description: Pay attention to gestures! The last one to salute discreetly loses.
salute.shortRule: The last one to copy the salute loses
salute.rules:
The card drawer must, at **any moment** of the game and as **discreetly as possible**, place their hand to their forehead in a salute gesture.

As soon as they notice, all other players must copy the gesture as fast as possible.

The **last** one to notice and do the gesture **loses**.

jokenpo.title: Rock-Paper-Scissors
jokenpo.description: Challenge someone to a Rock-Paper-Scissors duel. Best of 3. Whoever loses gets penalized.
jokenpo.rules:
The drawer chooses **1 opponent**.

Play **Rock-Paper-Scissors**, best of 3 rounds.

Whoever gets **fewer wins gets penalized**.

In case of a tie after 3 rounds, play an extra round until the tie is broken.

eye_to_eye.title: Eye to Eye
eye_to_eye.description: Everyone looks down. A 3-2-1 countdown plays, and everyone looks up at someone. The two people who lock eyes get penalized.
eye_to_eye.rules:
All players **look down**. The app plays a **3-2-1** countdown.

On *"Look up!"*, everyone must look directly at another person **at the same time**.

- Anyone who locks eyes with someone **gets penalized**: both of them
- The drawer selects from the list **which players** stared at each other

add_rule.title: Add a Rule
add_rule.description: Create a rule that will last for the rest of the game. Whoever breaks it gets penalized.
add_rule.rules:
The drawer invents **any rule** that will apply for the rest of the game.

**Examples:**
- *"No swearing allowed"*
- *"Everyone uses their left hand"*
- *"Whoever laughs loses"*
- *"Forbidden to say anyone's name"*

The rule stays visible in the **top bar** of the screen. Whoever breaks it **gets penalized**.

remove_rule.title: Remove a Rule
remove_rule.description: Remove an active rule from the game.
remove_rule.rules:
Removes **one of the active rules** from the game.

Active rules appear in the **top bar** of the screen. After removing it, the rule instantly stops applying.

If there are no active rules, the card has no effect.

shield.title: Shield
shield.description: You won a shield! Next time you are supposed to be penalized, the shield blocks it.
shield.rules:
You won a **shield**.

It goes into your inventory and is used **automatically** the next time you have to take a penalty: it is blocked and the shield disappears.

- **Single** use
- You can only have **1 active shield** at a time
- The shield blocks any type of penalty

bathroom.title: Bathroom Pass
bathroom.description: You won a free trip to the bathroom. Use it whenever you want without getting penalized.
bathroom.rules:
You won a **free trip to the bathroom**.

When you need to leave during the game, use the pass and go without taking a penalty.

- **Single** use and non-transferable
- Can be used at any time
- Without the pass, leaving without a penalty is forbidden

hot_potato.title: Hot Potato
hot_potato.description: Pass the 'potato' quickly! When the time runs out, whoever is holding it gets penalized.
hot_potato.shortRule: Don't get stuck with the potato!
hot_potato.rules:
Tap **"Start timer"** to begin.

Pass an object quickly to any person.

When the timer ends and the sound **explodes**, whoever is holding the potato **gets penalized**.

Select the unlucky one from the list.

duck_game.title: Duck What?
duck_game.description: Going clockwise, say 'duck' to pass to the next. 'What?' reverses the direction. 'Quack' skips the next person. Whoever messes up loses.
duck_game.rules:
Going **clockwise** starting from the drawer, each player uses one of three words:

- **"Duck"** → passes the turn to the next player
- **"What?"** → reverses the direction of the round
- **"Quack"** → skips the next player

Whoever **hesitates**, says the **wrong word**, or acts **out of order** loses.
